name: Dora-bench-256
description: Dora-bench-256 is a small (256-example) text benchmark hosted on Hugging Face intended to assess language models' performance on a curated set of prompts emphasizing instruction-following and short-form reasoning. It provides input prompts with reference outputs to enable automated evaluation of generation quality and correctness. The suite is compact and useful for quick comparative checks rather than large-scale model validation.
reputation: A small community dataset on Hugging Face with limited but increasing use for quick model checks and pilot evaluations.
